newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen slide on BOJ comments, land news.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen slide on BOJ comments, land news.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen futures dropped through key support levels on Tuesday following comments by a Bank of Japan (BOJ) official, which suggested that the recent rally in Japanese government bonds (JGBs) had been overdone.
Masayuki Matsushima, director of the BOJ's research and statistics department, said the market does not always move in line with fundamentals.
Dealers said the comments triggered speculation that the BOJ may be preparing to change its easy monetary policy stance.
A Japanese bank dealer said it was difficult to tell whether any stops had been triggered on the way down as volumes had been relatively thin.
December Euroyen was quoted at 99.10 at 0750 GMT after falling through its recent support at 99.17 and hitting a low of 99.08. June JGB futures were at 125.84 against their previous 126.59.
The dealer said December Euroyen was likely to be supported at 99.05.
Both ends of the Japanese yield curve came under pressure early in the day on news that Japan's Finance Ministry would announce measures to boost land liquidity on March 31.
The news spurred strong buying in Tokyo stocks, lifting the Nikkei share average by 391.70 points to close at 18,445.20.
